nodes.label: Clean Architecture Solution Template v10.8.0
nodes.rationale: Uses Clean Architecture Solution Template by Jason Taylor to separate domain, application, infrastructure, and web layers with CQRS MediatR and EditorConfig styles.

nodes.label: Hardware Receipt Printing Architecture (Farsi)
nodes.rationale: Evaluates web browser printing via window.print vs raw ESC/POS over TCP/IP socket to thermal printers on port 9100 without browser dialog prompts.

nodes.label: Cafe POS & On-Site Ordering Automation Proposal
nodes.norm_label: cafe pos & on-site ordering automation proposal

nodes.label: Cafe POS System Architecture
nodes.rationale: Layered architecture combining React/Zustand client frontend, SignalR real-time hub and Minimal REST APIs, .NET 10 MediatR CQRS core system, and EF Core relational database.

nodes.label: Hardware Receipt Printing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Provides web-native 80mm window.print as Phase 1 out-of-the-box solution and direct TCP ESC/POS printing on port 9100 for enterprise kitchen automation.

nodes.label: WebSocket JWT Query String Authentication
nodes.rationale: WebSockets cannot send custom HTTP headers during handshake, so JWT access token is transmitted via ?access_token query string and read by OnMessageReceived event in BearerToken handler.

nodes.label: CafeNotificationService Clean Architecture Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Application layer handlers depend on ICafeNotificationService abstraction instead of Web layer CafeHub directly, preserving Clean Architecture inversion of dependency.

nodes.label: SignalR CORS Credentials Policy
nodes.rationale: SignalR requires AllowCredentials, which crashes if combined with AllowAnyOrigin; solved by replacing with SetIsOriginAllowed(_ => true) in development and WithOrigins in production.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Project Layering Design
nodes.rationale: Organizes backend into Api, Application, Domain, and Infrastructure projects to cleanly map backend models to frontend Zustand stores.

nodes.label: Backend CORS Setup for Local React App
nodes.rationale: Configures CORS policy AllowReactApp in Program.cs to allow origin http://localhost:3000 with credentials and specific headers/methods.
nodes.norm_label: backend cors setup for local react app

nodes.label: Aspire Dynamic Backend URL Resolution
nodes.rationale: Aspire injects dynamic ports via services__webapi__http__0; Vite exposes them using envPrefix config; api.ts resolves explicit override, Aspire injection, and same-origin fallback in prioritized order.

nodes.label: Four-Phase Endpoint Integration Pattern
nodes.rationale: Standardizes endpoint consumption into Phase 0 (C# endpoint & command inspection), Phase 1 (URL resolution), Phase 2 (typed API service), Phase 3 (Zustand store), and Phase 4 (UI component).

nodes.label: Frontend-Backend Field Mapping Pattern
nodes.rationale: Stores perform explicit translation between frontend UI property names and C# command DTO property names to prevent coupling the UI directly to backend database schemas.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Error Handling Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates error duties across Layer 1 (Axios interceptor for 401/session expiry), Layer 2 (Zustand store parsing Problem Details RFC9110 and triggering toasts), and Layer 3 (UI component preventing modal dismissal).
